name: Meteor Swarm
description: Blazing orbs of fire plummet to the ground at four different points within range. Each creature in a 40-foot-radius sphere centered on each point chosen makes a Dex save, taking 20d6 fire and 20d6 bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half on a successful one.
